# Parley v0.1.13

This beta fixes coordination-core startup when an upgrade encounters a stale
or partially written filesystem relay endpoint from an older run.

## Fixed

- Parley no longer fails with a missing `inbox` error when its private relay
  transport contains an endpoint whose pane credential has already been
  revoked.
- Relay startup removes only owner-controlled, capability-named endpoints that
  are absent from the current credential store before cleaning live endpoints.
- Current pane credentials, retained Ghostty surfaces and terminal processes
  remain unchanged during the cleanup.
- A native regression check reproduces the exact missing-file failure and
  verifies that coordination starts normally after cleanup.

## Upgrade notes

- Quit Parley before replacing the existing application. Quitting ends its
  live pane processes and app-resident coordination core.
- Workspace definitions and local collaboration history remain compatible.
- Agent protocol v9 is unchanged, so existing v9 panes do not require a
  protocol restart.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.13-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings >
  Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.13-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
